description: Fixtures for INDIRECT-driven dynamic (CTRO) references. Selector (text "Branch.A") drives Pick (=INDIRECT(Selector)); Down (=Pick+1) is downstream. LoopName (text "Loop") drives Loop (=INDIRECT(LoopName)) into a dynamic self-cycle. CycA/CycB (each =INDIRECT of a name node pointing at the other) form a dynamic two-node cycle. StaticPick/MissPick use constant strings. Content is a single formula field (§6): unprefixed entries are literal constants (here, the path-strings are text).
